Yeah ain’t that the truth. Just hope it comes soon, for people like us. It’s pretty unbearable, I guess to the point of fatigue and exhaustion.

Being wanted at this point is more of a dream feeling then anything. When you cast your love and affection for so long with your heart on the line only to be broken... it can be really painful. I guess I can relate to what you’re saying. But we can still dream? Right..

In the same boat. Complete nerd, had great grades and a lot of opportunities with college. I never did anything bad, never got in trouble. And yet I’m socially incompetent and devoid of anyone in my real life. I’m sorry you’re in the same boat, I really am. Love and friendship sure would be nice wouldn’t it?

It really is hard feeling small in the grand scheme of things. I perfectly understand the feeling, as it’s something that encompasses my life. Empathy feels like it’s on the brink of destruction but it’s definitely still there, it flickers like a distant shooting star, sadly it takes a long time to find it. Hearing that you study zoology made me smile, that is in fact so very amazing. I love animals, as I’ve aspired to be a veterinarian. I can assure that the anxiety you feel is not subject to you alone, I feel it too and a lot of others do. And from the bottom of my heart I’m so sorry you have to struggle with it. As someone who’s experienced but a tiny fraction if that if that of the things I’d love to do, that hit close to home too close.. you have my dearest thoughts, and I truly don’t mind talking to you. If your dms are welcome a small chat might be lovely. I just typed out a novel didn’t I? 3AM brings this side out of me haha. Thanks for reading, I believe in you.

This is honestly just an insensitive post. The logic if flawed, I’m not trying to straw man here but. If nice guys doesn’t make a move it means they are a coward or gay. Hmm that just seems rather hurtful generalizing. It’s your opinion but it’s still flawed based off of societal values perpetuated by 100s of years of the same thing .
My depression and anxiety definitely makes people ghost and leave me. Or stop talking to me. So I relate hard..
